mapper.select: SELECT c1.category_id AS rootCategoryId, c1.name AS rootCategoryName, c2.category_id AS sectionCategoryId, c2.name AS sectionCategoryName, c3.category_id AS categoryId, c3.name AS categoryName FROM category c3 JOIN category c2 ON c3.parent_id = c2.category_id JOIN category c1 ON c2.parent_id = c1.category_id WHERE c1.use_yn = 'Y' AND c2.use_yn = 'Y' AND c3.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY c1.category_id, c2.category_id, c3.category_id
